string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_new_year
string-array.item: A new year begins. May none of your classes this year start at 8 a.m.
Happy New Year! Forget about homework, just for today.
Another page turned. Here\'s to a great year ahead.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_valentine
string-array.item: It\'s Valentine\'s Day. Date someone, or treat yourself. Both count.
Happy Valentine\'s Day! Even if your only date is your timetable, have something sweet.
May every message you get today be sweeter than a homework reminder.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_womens_day
string-array.item: Happy Women\'s Day! Stay free, confident and shining.
It\'s Women\'s Day. Buy yourself some flowers. You deserve them.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_arbor_day
string-array.item: It\'s Arbor Day. No tree to plant? Plant a small goal instead.
Arbor Day today. Go look at something green and rest your eyes.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_april_fools
string-array.item: It\'s April Fools\'. If someone says class is cancelled tomorrow, double-check.
Happy April Fools\'! Laugh it off when you get pranked, and prank kindly.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_labor_day
string-array.item: Happy Labour Day! You\'ve worked hard. Take a proper rest.
Happy May Day. Turn off the alarm and sleep in.
Here\'s to everyone who works hard, including you in class.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_youth_day
string-array.item: Happy Youth Day! Stay young and stay passionate.
It\'s Youth Day. Go do what you want while you\'re young.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_childrens_day
string-array.item: Happy Children\'s Day! You\'re never too old to be a kid for a day.
Be a little silly today. Being happy is what matters.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_teachers_day
string-array.item: It\'s Teachers\' Day. Say thanks to a teacher who helped you.
Happy Teachers\' Day! Paying attention in class is the best gift.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_national_day
string-array.item: Happy National Day! Put the timetable aside and rest.
No classes for a few days. Get out and enjoy yourself.
First day of the holiday. Sleep in, have fun, and travel safe.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_christmas_eve
string-array.item: It\'s Christmas Eve. Stay safe and get some rest tonight.
Christmas Eve today. Treat yourself to something nice.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_christmas
string-array.item: Merry Christmas! Good luck with finals, and lots of presents.
Merry Christmas! Have a happy day.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_mothers_day
string-array.item: It\'s Mother\'s Day. Give your mum a call.
Happy Mother\'s Day. Don\'t forget to tell her you love her.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_fathers_day
string-array.item: It\'s Father\'s Day. Send your dad a message. He\'ll be happier than he lets on.
Happy Father\'s Day. Ask your dad how he\'s been.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_new_years_eve
string-array.item: It\'s New Year\'s Eve. Enjoy the reunion dinner.
Happy New Year\'s Eve! Make a wish at midnight.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_spring_festival
string-array.item: Happy Lunar New Year! Wishing you luck and plenty of red envelopes.
Happy New Year! May this term go smoothly.
Happy Spring Festival. Today is just for eating and having fun.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_lantern
string-array.item: Happy Lantern Festival! Had some tangyuan yet?
Full moon, full house. Good luck with the new term.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_dragon_head
string-array.item: Today the dragon raises its head. A good day for a haircut.
The dragon raises its head, and so does your luck. Have a great term.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_dragon_boat
string-array.item: Happy Dragon Boat Festival! Sweet zongzi or savoury?
Wishing you good health this Dragon Boat Festival. Relax a little.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_qixi
string-array.item: It\'s Qixi. To couples and singles alike: be happy.
Happy Qixi. Look up at the Milky Way tonight.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_mid_autumn
string-array.item: Happy Mid-Autumn! Look at the moon tonight and have a mooncake.
Wherever you are, happy Mid-Autumn Festival.
It\'s Mid-Autumn. Give your family a call.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_double_ninth
string-array.item: It\'s the Double Ninth Festival. Climb somewhere high, and call your grandparents.
Clear skies for Double Ninth. A good day for a walk.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_festival_laba
string-array.item: It\'s Laba. Have a warm bowl of Laba congee. New Year is close.
After Laba comes the New Year. Hang in there, the break is coming.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_spring_equinox
string-array.item: Spring Equinox: day and night are equal today.
It\'s the Spring Equinox. Go see some flowers.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_pure_brightness
string-array.item: It\'s Qingming. Travel safe.
Qingming often brings rain. Take an umbrella.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_grain_rain
string-array.item: Grain Rain: the last solar term of spring. Enjoy it.
Grain Rain today. Expect showers.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_start_of_summer
string-array.item: Summer officially starts today. Drink plenty of water.
Start of Summer. Time for watermelon.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_grain_buds
string-array.item: Grain Buds: a little full is just right.
It\'s Grain Buds. Be content with a little.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_grain_in_ear
string-array.item: Grain in Ear: busy sowing and harvesting. Finals are near. Keep going.
It\'s getting hot. Stay cool.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_summer_solstice
string-array.item: Summer Solstice: the longest day of the year.
It\'s hot today. Don\'t stay in the sun too long.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_minor_heat
string-array.item: Minor Heat: it\'s warming up. Stay cool.
Minor Heat today. Have some watermelon.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_major_heat
string-array.item: Major Heat: the hottest time of the year. Wear sunscreen.
Drink water and don\'t stay up too late.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_start_of_autumn
string-array.item: Autumn starts today, though the heat will linger a while.
Start of Autumn. Time to eat well.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_end_of_heat
string-array.item: End of Heat: summer is nearly over.
Mornings and evenings are getting cooler.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_white_dew
string-array.item: White Dew: it\'s cooler now. Bring a layer.
Autumn is settling in. Don\'t catch a cold.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_autumn_equinox
string-array.item: Autumn Equinox: day and night are equal again.
Crisp autumn weather. A good day for a walk.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_cold_dew
string-array.item: Cold Dew: it\'s getting chilly. Dress warmly.
Big temperature swings today. Don\'t catch a cold.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_frost_descent
string-array.item: Frost\'s Descent: the last solar term of autumn. Keep warm.
It\'s getting colder. Leaving bed will only get harder.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_start_of_winter
string-array.item: Winter starts today. Bring a jacket.
Start of Winter. Warm up with some dumplings.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_minor_snow
string-array.item: Minor Snow: it\'s cold. Dress warmly.
Early classes just got harder. You\'ve got this.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_major_snow
string-array.item: Major Snow: keep warm and watch your step.
Wishing you a warm winter.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_winter_solstice
string-array.item: It\'s the Winter Solstice. Had your dumplings?
The shortest day of the year. Days get longer from here.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_minor_cold
string-array.item: Minor Cold: bundle up.
Hang in there through finals. Winter break is ahead.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_major_cold
string-array.item: Major Cold: the last solar term. Spring is on its way.
It\'s cold, but the New Year is almost here.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_start_of_spring
string-array.item: Spring starts today.
Start of Spring. May your year bloom.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_rain_water
string-array.item: Rain Water: it\'s warming up and the spring rain is coming.
Take an umbrella today.

string-array.name: greeting_lines_term_awakening_of_insects
string-array.item: Awakening of Insects: spring thunder wakes everything up.
Time to wake up for the new term, too.
